<!--
  The simple rating (model rating@1): the score (large), the heading that names it, a line (the count, the
  scale) and the source as a link. Axes: layout (bar: one row on a card surface from md up, centered: centred,
  one under the other).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

  export type RatingSimpleProps = {
    id: string;
    value: string;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    sourceLabel?: string;
    sourceHref?: string;
    level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
    padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
    layout?: "bar" | "centered";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import LinkPlain from "../compose/LinkPlain.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    value,
    title,
    description = "",
    sourceLabel = "",
    sourceHref = "",
    level = 2,
    padding = "standard",
    layout = "bar",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: RatingSimpleProps = $props();
  const titleId = $derived(id + "-title");
  const box = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "bar" ? "flex flex-col gap-4 rounded bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground border border-border md:flex-row md:items-center md:gap-8"
    : "flex flex-col items-center gap-4 text-center"
  );
  const copy = $derived(((layout as string) === "bar") ? "md:grow" : "");
  const copyAlign = $derived(((layout as string) === "bar") ? "start" : "center");
  const copyText = $derived(((layout as string) === "bar") ? "text-start" : "text-center");
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class={
    (padding as string) === "compact" ? "py-8 lg:py-16"
    : (padding as string) === "spacious" ? "py-24 lg:py-40"
    : "py-16 lg:py-32"
  }
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
  data-slot="rating-simple"
>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
    <Box class={box}>
      <Text size="5xl" weight="bold" class="tracking-tight text-primary">
        {value}
      </Text>
      <Stack gap="2" align={copyAlign} class={copy}>
        <Title as={level} size="xl" weight="semibold" class={copyText} id={titleId}>
          {title}
        </Title>
        {#if description}
          <Text size="sm" class={cn("text-muted-foreground", copyText)}>
            {description}
          </Text>
        {/if}
      </Stack>
      {#if (sourceLabel && sourceHref)}
        <LinkPlain href={urlOf(sourceHref)} class="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">
          <Text size="sm">
            {sourceLabel}
          </Text>
        </LinkPlain>
      {/if}
    </Box>
  </Container>
</Block>
